name: Kuze Souma
source:
"I'll be by your side no matter what happens."

A man who was invited to the castle.
Although he means well, he can be overbearing at times, which is why [url=/c53689]Seisuke[/url] calls him "My Lord."
When he heard about [url=/c53686]Zakuro's[/url] past, he proudly proclaimed "I will be your little brother!" to her.
He has a strange way of thinking but he's a nice person.
